title: The interactive lesson player (`lesson-player`): a new SCREEN that runs a lesson as Warm-up, I do, We do, You do and Exit ticket, on the board or self-paced

template.also: A SCREEN card (lane lf-hosts), not a print template: the player draws every question region with the existing screen cell (`screen-cell.js`, `.mq-scell`) and reads the lesson records in `js/modules/lessons/library.js` (lessonData / engineRecord), `sheet/roles/lesson.js` (pickExample, pickWeDo) and `sheet/anchors.js` (stepState, sayLineOf). Mock: `design/cards/lesson-player/mock-ido-board-1280.html` + `.png`.

summary: ONE player runs a lesson on screen in five parts, Warm-up -> I do -> We do -> You do -> Exit ticket, in two modes: Board (teacher-led, whole class, big type, presenter controls, reveal on click, saves nothing about pupils) and Pupil (self-paced, part reached and exit score saved). Every part is GENERATED from the lesson record the print packet already uses and dealt through generateQuestionFor with seeds, so a lesson replays identically and matches its printed packet. Every question region is the black-and-white Andika screen cell (SP-1, SP-2); everything coloured is chrome outside it (SP-30; INK-30 for the step numerals only). One pure function planLesson(lessonId, {seed, mode}) -> {parts:[{part, items, steps?, say?}]} deals everything; no part generates on its own (P-ON-2). Skills: none of its own; it plays every library lesson's skills (lesson.practice, lesson.warmup), first add-within-10 (addition:add_facts band 10, constant 1-3).
teaches: Whatever the lesson teaches: the player is the I do / We do / You do sequence of PEDAGOGY_STANDARD (P-1 one new thing per step, P-17 the Say band, P-LC-7 guided at level 2, P-LC-9 worked steps redrawn per step, P-ON-1 Learn runs worked -> guided -> own on the same cell) put on screen for one lesson, plus a 3-item scored exit ticket.
research: From repo sources: PEDAGOGY_STANDARD section 11 (online modes mirror page roles, the hint ladder rungs 1-4, P-ON-1..8), WORKSHEET_DESIGN_STANDARD SP-1..SP-40 (screen parts), PAGE_TYPES PT-PKT-1 / PT-ANC-1 (packet parts, the anchor example), roles/lesson.js (the packet anatomy), the existing board display (teacher-shell.js tv-bigboard). Interactive grammar (IXL 'learn with an example', Boom Learning task-card reveal, presentation-clicker conventions): reveal one step per click, read aloud, then try one; ours keeps one boxed B&W cell and the Steps strip of the printed anchor chart.
problemTypes: Warm-up: 1-3 cells, one per prerequisite skill (lesson.warmup, else routine.skills), each with its library instruction and its own input; feedback on Check; unscored; Board: Show answer per cell; a miss shows the Prerequisite Check's 'If missed -> Lesson ...' line in chrome.

I do (step reveal): state k of n = the cell redrawn as after step k (provider workedSteps + anchors.js stepState; P-LC-9: step k marks grey, earlier black), the step's own sentence under the drawing (L6), Steps strip row k outlined, later rows grey; Next reveals k+1, Back returns; no input. After the LAST step the Say band (BD-8, full width under the cell, cell ink) shows the real filled Say line (sayLineOf, e.g. 'Say: 6 plus 3 equals 9.'), read once; then 'Say it together' (chrome) waits. The routine's chant, if any, under Say.

We do (hint fade): 2-3 items (routine.guided cases via pickWeDo, else the practice skill) at level 2 (P-LC-7); item 1 at rung 1 (next step's marks grey + sentence), item 2 rung 2 (sentence), item 3 rung 3 ('What comes next?' + Steps row highlighted); a correct item moves the next one down a rung, a wrong Check keeps it (P-ON-7); a hint never fills a slot (P-ON-8); live per-digit feedback (SP-31). Board: teacher drives the rung with Hint / Next.
You do: the existing practice-card host embedded unchanged (D9): 6 items of lesson.practice (practiceBlocks[0] opts if present), Check, Skip, wrong-retry, end-of-run, hint ladder on request.

Exit ticket: 3 items of the practice skill (one per routine case where there are 3; a detailed lesson's 'exit' skill), Test level (scaffold 0, hints off, on Check once, no retry), score n/3 with accuracy only (P-ON-4); saved per D7; 0-1/3 shows 'Re-teach: replay I do' (chrome).
progression: Part order is fixed (P-1, P-ON-1): Warm-up -> I do -> We do -> You do -> Exit ticket; any part reachable from the part rail; repeat or skip any part.
Scaffold fades across the parts: I do level 3 (worked) -> We do level 2 with rungs 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> You do level 1 (hints on request) -> Exit level 0.

Build slices, smallest first (D8): 1 planLesson + I do, Board, add-within-10, URL launch; 2 Warm-up + We do, both modes; 3 You do + Exit ticket + save + dashboard row; 4 launch buttons, detailed lessons, every library lesson swept.

drawing.sizes: Board at 1280: cell digits 104 px, text 30 px, Steps 26 px, controls >= 64 px; board at 1920: x1.5; Pupil: the card scale of .mq-scell (40-56 px digits), digit inputs >= 48 px (SP-10, plan item 7). Tablet 820 / 1024: the Steps strip becomes one chip row above the cell (L11).
notes: Frame: top bar (I Can title from the provider iCan as on the packet, mode pill, part rail of 5 pills >= 48 px, aria-current), stage (Steps strip from routine.steps with INK-30 numerals + the .mq-scell cell), bottom presenter / pupil bar (Back, Read aloud, step k of n, key legend, Next / Show answer / New numbers on Board).
BUILD REQUIREMENT (lead 2026-11-20, mock fix): the Say band shows the REAL filled Say line after the last I do step (never a placeholder); before it the band is absent, not a grey stub.

BUILD REQUIREMENT (lead 2026-11-20, mock fix): the Steps column has no empty band (H13): it is sized to its content (the Rule / chant line under the steps where the routine has one) and the column never stretches below its last row; --render measures it.

Content never shrinks to fit: a drawing too big for the stage takes the whole stage and the Steps strip collapses to chips. No colour, emoji or non-Andika type inside the cell (L7); feedback tints on the chrome frame only (SP-33).

ownerRulings.ruling: D1 Source APPROVED as recommended: Library lessons (lessonById + lessonData / engineRecord, library.js) drive all five parts; the 7 detailed lessons join in slice 4 through skills.used[].role (main / P0 / P1 / exit).
ownerRulings.source: lead via coordinator, 2026-11-20 (lane lf-hosts card review)

ownerRulings.ruling: D2 Seeds APPROVED as recommended: The packet seed S (default hash(lessonId)); part offsets Warm-up S+100+i, We do S+200+i, You do S+300+i, Exit S+900+i; the I do example is the anchor chart's own example (pickExample) for S, so screen = printed packet (P-ON-5); Board 'New numbers' bumps S by 1 and shows the seed in the teacher footer.
ownerRulings.source: lead via coordinator, 2026-11-20 (lane lf-hosts card review)

ownerRulings.ruling: D3 Board launch APPROVED as recommended: A 'Teach on board' button on the lesson's row in the teacher Lessons / WRM screen and on the lesson print screen; it opens the existing board display (body.tv-bigboard, ?board=1 window, teacher-shell.js).
ownerRulings.source: lead via coordinator, 2026-11-20 (lane lf-hosts card review)

ownerRulings.ruling: D4 Pupil launch APPROVED as recommended: A 'Lesson' card in the student explorer / Quick start for any skill with a defaultFor lesson, and a share link ?lesson=<id>&s=<seed>; the pupil resumes at the last part reached.
ownerRulings.source: lead via coordinator, 2026-11-20 (lane lf-hosts card review)

ownerRulings.ruling: D5 Hosts and targets? APPROVED as recommended: 820 / 1024 (tablet: Steps as a chip row above the cell), 1280 / 1366 (Steps strip beside the cell), 1920 board / projector (x1.5 board vars); every control >= 48 px, board controls >= 64 px; no 390 (plan item 7); no horizontal scroll; content never shrinks.
ownerRulings.source: lead via coordinator, 2026-11-20 (lane lf-hosts card review)

ownerRulings.ruling: D6 Keys, clicker and read-aloud? APPROVED as recommended: Right / Space / PageDown = next, Left / PageUp = back (what clickers send), R = read again, H = hint, A = show answer (Board), Esc = leave; keys ignored inside a digit input except Enter and Tab. TTS (hints-speech.js speakExplanation / stopSpeaking, the settings toggle) reads each step sentence and the filled Say line: automatic in Pupil I do, on demand on the Board; speech stops on every navigation.
ownerRulings.source: lead via coordinator, 2026-11-20 (lane lf-hosts card review)

ownerRulings.ruling: D7 Exit ticket save APPROVED as recommended: No new store: updateSkillProgress per item (progress.js) plus ONE state.sessionHistory row {type:'lesson-exit', lessonId, seed, score, of:3, date} through the game-flow saver; the teacher sees a 'Lesson exit' row in the dashboard session list and the skill's mastery bar; Board mode never saves. Consistent with P-ON-6.
ownerRulings.source: lead via coordinator, 2026-11-20 (lane lf-hosts card review)

ownerRulings.ruling: D8 First slice? APPROVED as recommended: I do only, Board mode, lesson add-within-10 (Y1.B2.S9), launched by URL ?lesson=add-within-10&mode=board; full independent critic (first build of a new screen).
ownerRulings.source: lead via coordinator, 2026-11-20 (lane lf-hosts card review)

ownerRulings.ruling: D9 You do APPROVED as recommended: Embed the existing practice-card host unchanged: the same cell, Check, Skip, wrong-retry and end-of-run rules (game-control.js recordQuestionStatus, test-wrong-retry-skip.cjs); 6 items; hint ladder on request.
ownerRulings.source: lead via coordinator, 2026-11-20 (lane lf-hosts card review)

ownerRulings.ruling: D10 Gate tool? APPROVED as recommended: A new tests/scripts/ws-lesson-player.mjs with --unit (node: planLesson deterministic, I do == anchor example, steps == workedSteps, Say has only the item's numbers), --render (every part, both modes, every host: no scroll, targets, B&W Andika cell, no emoji, H13), --reveal, --hints, --exit; on ws-precritic's path.
ownerRulings.source: lead via coordinator, 2026-11-20 (lane lf-hosts card review)

ownerRulings.ruling: Screen cards get a card.json and pass `ws-spec-card --check-signed` like every other card: no exemption for screen cards.
ownerRulings.source: lead via coordinator, 2026-11-20 (lane lf-hosts card review)

misconceptions.error: the player invents steps a provider does not give (workedSteps with 1 or 0 steps)
the screen example differs from the printed anchor chart for the same seed
misconceptions.wrong: I do 5 + 2 on screen, 6 + 3 on the chart

misconceptions.error: a hint writes into the answer slot (P-ON-8)
the board saves the class's answers as one pupil's exit score
misconceptions.wrong: a 'Lesson exit 3/3' row from the board

options: The player has no skill options of its own: each part deals the lesson's skills with the option values the lesson record carries (lesson.practice.opts, warmup opts, practiceBlocks), unchanged and editable only in the lesson.
Player settings: mode (board | pupil), seed (Board 'New numbers'), read-aloud auto (on in Pupil I do, off on Board).

gates.note: planLesson for every library lesson x 2 seeds byte-equal twice; I do == anchor example; steps == workedSteps; Say has only the item's numbers (P-ON-5, P-17, L6)

every part, both modes, 820 / 1024 / 1280 / 1366 / 1920: no horizontal scroll, controls >= 48 px (Board >= 64), cell ink #000 / #fff / #949494, Andika only, no emoji, no empty band >= 30 % incl. the Steps column (SP-2, SP-10, L7, H13)
n reveals = n distinct cell states, newest marks grey, Back restores, keys and clicker keys work, speech text == step sentence, Say band == sayLineOf after the last step (P-LC-9, BD-8)
We do rungs 1 -> 2 -> 3 on correct items; no hint writes an input (P-ON-7, P-ON-8)
3 items, one {type:'lesson-exit'} history row, score correct, Board saves nothing (D7)
and ws-screen-answer on the player's cells (L5, L14, SP-3)
unchanged and green with the card host embedded (D9)
row: the first mock's empty Steps column FAILS --render H13; the fixed mock passes

openQuestions.q: D9 You do: reuse or new practice view?
openQuestions.recommended: Embed the existing practice-card host unchanged: the same cell, Check, Skip, wrong-retry and end-of-run rules (game-control.js recordQuestionStatus, test-wrong-retry-skip.cjs); 6 items; hint ladder on request. **ANSWER: lead 2026-11-20: approved as recommended.**

A new tests/scripts/ws-lesson-player.mjs with --unit (node: planLesson deterministic, I do == anchor example, steps == workedSteps, Say has only the item's numbers), --render (every part, both modes, every host: no scroll, targets, B&W Andika cell, no emoji, H13), --reveal, --hints, --exit; on ws-precritic's path. **ANSWER: lead 2026-11-20: approved as recommended.**

An independent critic (medium) grades the rendered PNGs of every part, both modes, at 820 / 1024 / 1280 / 1366 / 1920, for 3 lessons (add-within-10, one place-value, one detailed lesson): 1 Teaching (one new thing per step, steps follow the item, Say filled and spoken, real hint fade, exit at level 0); 2 Look (B&W Andika cell, big digits, chrome outside, nothing squeezed, no empty band); 3 Use (48 / 64 px targets, keyboard + clicker, TTS, resume, Skip / retry identical to the card host); 4 Truth to the lesson (every part traceable to record and seed, replay identical, matches the printed packet). Each >= 8; one 7 fails.

Risks: uneven workedSteps (show the anchor's single state, report the skill, never invent steps); templates without stepState (sentence only, listed); board scale overflow on card-measured templates (Steps collapse, content never shrinks). Out of scope: phone width, authoring lessons, per-pupil live response, printing from the player, the paused long atomised lessons, new skills.
